name: A Household Affair
source:
Ethan Miller is the perfect housekeeper. Not only does he cook for you, but he cleans for you, and he's gentle and even takes care of your soul. How did this flawless man come to work at your residence? Only you can open the Pandora's Box he's hiding.

[From in-app]
